question:
(i) Name the spectral series obtained when an electron falls to $n_f=1$ in hydrogen atom.
(ii) In which region of the electromagnetic spectrum does this series lie?

options.A:
(i) Transitions to $n_f=1$ form the Balmer series.
(ii) It lies in the visible region.
options.B:
(i) Transitions to $n_f=1$ form the Paschen series.
(ii) It lies in the infrared region.
options.C:
(i) Transitions ending at $n_f=1$ form the Lyman series.
(ii) The Lyman series lies in the ultraviolet region.
options.D:
(i) Transitions ending at $n_f=1$ form the Brackett series.
(ii) It lies in the microwave region.
